?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:4981
Court No. - 15

Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 82 of 2024
Applicant :- Tanveer Ahmad Khan
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru.
Regional

Forest Officer Forest Deptt. Sharda Nagar
Counsel for Applicant :- Alok Kumar Singh,Sanjay Singh Chauhan
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.
1. Learned A.G.A informs that he has procured complete instructions in the matter including
complete case diary and the matter pertains to a complaint case.

2. Heard Shri Alok Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
3.

The present anticipatory bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Tanveer Ahmad Khan in Case No. 1398 of 2020, Range Case No.27/2020-2021, under Sections 33/63 Indian Forest Act & 409/420 IPC Range Sharda Nagar, District Lakhimpur Kheri, with the prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail as he is apprehending arrest in the above-mentioned case.
4. Learned counsel for the accused-applicant while pressing the bail application submits that it is a case of false implication.

The allegations which have been levelled in the complaint by the Forest Tanveer Ahmad Khan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Regional Forest ... on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130568174/
1 Official/ Officer / complainant are false, concocted and could not be believed on the touch stone of probability.

entities.text: Forest Tanveer Ahmad Khan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Regional Forest
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant is a resident of a village situated at the outskirts of reserved forest and he was not in a position to meet the illegal demands of the Forest Officers and it is only on this account this false case has been lodged against the applicant.
5. It is further submitted that even if all the allegations levelled in the complaint are believed on its face Section 409 and 420 IPC may not attract for want of necessary ingredients.

The applicant is ready to cooperate in the trial and would remain present before the trial court as and when his presence would be required and still no process of 82 Cr.P.C. has been issued against the applicant and he is ready to remain present before the trial court as and when his presence would be required.

6. It is also submitted that identically placed co-accused Heera and Jabir Ali have been granted the facility of anticipatory bail by the Coordinate Benches of this Court, vide orders dated 4.10.2021 and 14.12.2022 passed in CRIMINAL MISC ANTICIPATORY BAIL APPLICATION U/S 438 CR.P.C.
Nos. - 7025 of 2021 and 2086 of 2022, respectively.
7. Learned AGA on the other hand submits that the applicant is accused of committing of grave offence and therefore he is not entitled for any protection.
8. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is reflected that allegations against the applicant and other co-accused persons are identical.
Identically placed co-accused persons, namely, Heera and Jabir Ali have already been granted facility of anticipatory bail by the Coordinate Benches of this Court.
The role of the instant applicant is at par with them.

9. Various submissions have been raised by learned counsel for the applicant with regard to the invocation of Section 409 and 420 IPC for want of necessary ingredients, however, the same are subject matter of the trial.

10. Having regard to all the facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra (2011) 1 SCC 694 as well as in Sushila Aggarwal v. State (NCT of Delhi) (2020) 5 SCC 1 and in Nathu Singh Vs State of U.P. and Others, 2021(6) SCC 64, MANU/SC/0360/2021, the facility of anticipatory bail may safely be extended to the applicant.

sentences.text:
11. Thus, the instant anticipatory bail application moved on behalf of the applicant- Tanveer Ahmad Khan is allowed and it is provided that in the event of arrest of the applicant, involved in the above noted case or on his surrender before the trial court within 20 days from today i.e. on or before 06.02.2024, whichever is earlier, he shall be released forthwith on anticipatory bail on hi furnishing a personal bond with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court concerned,
subject to the following conditions:
1. The applicant if not arrested earlier, shall surrender before the trial court within 20 days from today i.e. on or before 06.02.2024 and will cooperate in the trial.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2. The applicant shall Cooperate in the investigation and will make himself available as and when required by the Investigating officer of the case, even for the recovery of any fact, if the case is directed to be further investigated.
3. The applicant shall not make any attempt to influence the prosecution witnesses and will also not commit any crime during her release on anticipatory bail.
4. The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence and especially when the prosecution witnesses are present in court.

5. The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on the dates fixed for (i) opening of the case, (ii) framing of charge and (iii) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.
12.

If in the opinion of the trial court default of any of the condition placed above is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the trial court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of their bail and shall proceed against him in accordance with law.

13. It is clarified that all the observations contained in this order are only for disposal of this anticipatory bail application and shall not affect the proceedings before the trial court in any manner.
